description_en: Queries the backup sets of released ApsaraDB RDS for MySQL instances
description_zh: 该接口用于查看已被释放的RDS MySQL实例的备份集列表
name: DescribeDetachedBackups

parameters.help_en: The instance ID. You can call DescribeDBInstances to query the instance ID
parameters.name: db_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The backup set status. Valid values:
Success: The backup is complete.
Failed: The backup failed
parameters.help_zh:
备份集状态，取值：
Success：已完成备份
Failed：备份失败
parameters.name: backup_status

parameters.help_en:
The backup mode. Valid values:

Automated: automatic backup.
Manual: manual backup
parameters.help_zh:
备份模式，取值：

Automated：系统自动备份
Manual：手动备份
parameters.name: backup_mode

parameters.help_en: The start time of the query. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ (UTC)
parameters.help_zh: 查询开始时间。 格式：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ（UTC时间）
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end time of the query. The end time must be later than the start time. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ (UTC)
parameters.help_zh: 查询结束时间，需要大于查询开始时间。 格式：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ（UTC时间）
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries per page. Valid values:
30
50
100

Default value: 30
parameters.help_zh:
每页记录数，取值：
30
50
100

默认值：30
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The page number. The value must be a positive integer that does not exceed the maximum value of the Integer data type.

Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh:
页码，取值：大于0且不超过Integer的最大值。

默认值为1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The region in which the instance resides
parameters.name: region

BackupDownloadURL.description_en: The public download URL. If the backup set is not available for download, an empty string is returned
BackupDownloadURL.description_zh: 公网下载地址，若当前不可下载，则为空串

BackupEndTime.description_en: The end time of the backup. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ (UTC)
BackupEndTime.description_zh: 本次备份结束时间。 格式：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ（UTC时间）

BackupIntranetDownloadURL.description_en: The internal download URL. If the backup set is not available for download, an empty string is returned
BackupIntranetDownloadURL.description_zh: 内网下载地址，若当前不可下载，则为空串

BackupMethod.description_en:
The backup method. Valid values:

Logical: logical backup.
Physical: physical backup.
Snapshot: snapshot backup
BackupMethod.description_zh:
备份方式，返回值：

Logical：逻辑备份
Physical：物理备份
Snapshot：快照备份

BackupMode.description_en:
The backup mode. Valid values:

Automated: automatic backup.
Manual: manual backup
BackupMode.description_zh:
备份模式，返回值：

Automated：系统自动备份
Manual：手动备份

BackupSize.description_en: The size of the backup file. Unit: bytes

BackupStartTime.description_en: The start time of the backup. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ (UTC)
BackupStartTime.description_zh: 本次备份开始时间。 格式：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ（UTC时间）

BackupStatus.description_en:
The backup set status. Valid values:

Success: The backup is complete.
Failed: The backup failed
BackupStatus.description_zh:
备份集状态，返回值：

Success：已完成备份
Failed：备份失败

BackupType.description_en:
The backup type. Valid values:

FullBackup: full backup.
IncrementalBackup: incremental backup
BackupType.description_zh:
备份类型，返回值：

FullBackup：全量备份
IncrementalBackup：增量备份

ConsistentTime.description_en:
The consistent time point of the backup set. The value is a UNIX timestamp.

This parameter is returned only for MySQL 5.6. For other versions, 0 is returned
ConsistentTime.description_zh:
备份集的一致性时间点。返回值为时间戳。

仅MySQL 5.6返回本参数，其他版本返回0

HostInstanceID.description_en: The ID of the instance that generated the backup set. This parameter is used to indicate whether the backup set was generated on the primary instance or the secondary instance
HostInstanceID.description_zh: 产生备份集的实例编号，用于区分该备份集产生于主实例或备实例

IsAvail.description_en:
Indicates whether the backup set is available. Valid values:

0: unavailable.
1: available
IsAvail.description_zh:
备份集是否可用，返回值：

0：不可用
1：可用

MetaStatus.description_en:
The status of the backup set used for database and table restoration. Valid values:

OK: normal.
LARGE: The number of tables is too large for database and table restoration.
EMPTY: The backup failed
MetaStatus.description_zh:
库表恢复的备份集状态，返回值：

OK：正常。
LARGE：表数量过多，不能用于库表恢复。
EMPTY：备份失败的备份集

StoreStatus.description_en:
Indicates whether the data backup can be deleted. Valid values:

Enabled: The backup can be deleted.
Disabled: The backup cannot be deleted
StoreStatus.description_zh:
该数据备份是否可删除，返回值：

Enabled：可删除
Disabled：不可删除

PageRecordCount.description_en: The number of backup sets on the current page
